courses.notes: Borderline distance (Temple, Bell County, roughly 65-70 miles north of downtown Austin via I-35). Municipal course open to public year-round with range, pitching/chipping area and putting green. Opened December 1922 as the 9-hole Lake Polk Golf and Country Club; second nine added in the 1950s; redesigned in the mid-1980s under former mayor John F. Sammons Jr. (no golf architect named). Black tees 6,597 yds (72.5/137), par 72.
